thread:
jason (vision-engineering): Heads up, noticed a ~35% GPU spend spike in us-west last billing cycle. Reserved coverage % dropped for Vision projects.

maria (eng-infra): Oof. Did reserved instances move to another tag/project?

jason (vision-engineering): Looks like reserved capacity is being applied to the infra:shared tag cluster rather than the vision product tags. Billing export shows reserved discounts not matching project labels.

kevin (finance-ops): Do we have the BigQuery query for coverage by label? Can you paste results?

sara (platform): I ran a quick check, see snippet: 

```
SELECT
  resource.label."project" AS project,
  sku.description AS sku,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost,
  SUM(reserved_amount) AS reserved_applied
FROM `billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXX` b
WHERE usage_start_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND sku.description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY project, sku
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

sara (platform): Output shows ~60% of reserved_applied rows have project = "infra-shared" even though VMs are attached to vision-* node pools.

maria (eng-infra): That smells like a tag propagation issue at node-pool / instance template creation time. Maybe our k8s cloud labels aren't being copied to the instance.

jason (vision-engineering): We recently changed node-pool bootstrap to use a shared instance-template generator in infra repo. Could be missing labels in the template.

kevin (finance-ops): This is causing Vision to be charged full price while infra-shared benefits. Need to backcharge or credit. Ops, please confirm scope before I request accounting adjustments.

maria (eng-infra): Action plan: 1) Confirm which clusters/node-pools are affected 2) Patch infra repo to propagate project/product tags into instance labels 3) Backfill labels on existing instances 4) File cloud support ticket for reserved allocation reassignment if provider allows 5) Create chargeback/credit for Vision.

ops-bot: Incident created: INFRA-4521 Tag propagation bug affecting reserved instance attribution. Assignee: maria. Priority: P2.

sara (platform): To list affected instances I used: 
```
gcloud compute instances list --filter="labels.project:(vision OR infra-shared) AND zone:(us-west1-*)" --format="json(name,labels,zone)"
```

sara (platform): Found ~28 GPU instances with missing "project" label.

maria (eng-infra): I'm going to run a backfill script to add the correct labels (will patch instance metadata so billing export picks up). I'll also add a CI check to the instance-template generator.

jason (vision-engineering): Thanks — please ping me before changes so we can coordinate rolling updates (don't want to kill pods).

maria (eng-infra): Will do. Tentative windows: tonight 2200 PST for a low-impact batch, then tomorrow morning for the rest.

kevin (finance-ops): For accounting: if cloud provider can't reassign reserved discounts retroactively, I'll prepare a credit for Vision for the differential. Need exact dollars. Sara/maria can you export a per-project delta?

sara (platform): I'll run the BigQuery delta: reserved_applied_if_labels_corrected - reserved_applied_actual per project and dump to a sheet.

maria (eng-infra): Filing support ticket now — include billing export rows + list of instance IDs. If provider can re-map reserved allocations we get better outcome.

billing-bot: Support ticket filed: GCP-CASE-123456. Status: Open.

jason (vision-engineering): Appreciate the quick triage. One ask: can we add a preventative dashboard that shows reserved coverage per product weekly? That would've caught this sooner.

maria (eng-infra): Agreed. I'll add a dashboard card to the infra cost board and an alert if coverage drops >10% week-over-week.

kevin (finance-ops): Perfect. Once we have the delta sheet and support ticket updates I'll loop in accounting for credits.

sara (platform): Quick note on remediation script (example): 
```
for instance in $(cat affected_instances.txt); do
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $instance --labels project=vision --zone=$zone
done
```

maria (eng-infra): I'll run in dry-run first, post the list here.

jason (vision-engineering): :thumbsup: 

maria (eng-infra): Dry-run complete, 12 instances would be relabeled in tonight's batch. No restarts. Pushing patch to infra repo now: PR #842.

ops-bot: PR #842 created in infra/instance-templates by maria.

kevin (finance-ops): Thanks team. Please update INFRA-4521 with final cost delta once calculated so I can close the bookkeeping loop.

maria (eng-infra): Will do. Follow-ups: add CI check + dashboard + backfill finished by EOD tomorrow.

jason (vision-engineering): Sounds good. Keep me posted if anything risky comes up during the update.
